source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: The nightly ledger export breaks the downstream ETL importer whenever a free-text note contains a comma or newline. Fix the CSV writer.
constraints: The file is consumed only by our internal ETL importer (an RFC 4180 parser), never opened in spreadsheets.
Output for fields without special characters must stay byte-identical.
input.context: Ledger export job (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). toCsv() writes CRLF-separated rows.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: CSV/formula injection (=CMD) hardening, which matters for spreadsheets but the constraint says the consumer is only the ETL parser; or 'use a CSV library'.
